result.title: FastAgent: A Physics-Aware FastFluent-to-Fluent Workflow for Rapid CFD Screening and Industrial Steam Dewaxing Design
result.comment: 47 pages, 6 main-text figures. Supplementary Information included
result.summary: Industrial computational fluid dynamics (CFD) becomes costly when complex geometries, long transients and coupled physics must be evaluated across large design spaces. We introduce FastAgent, a physics-aware campaign controller built around FastFluent, a lightweight numerical engine for rapid physical screening. FastFluent supplies stage-specific fields and diagnostics; FastAgent allocates physical models, numerical resolution and simulation horizons by the active quantities of interest (QoIs), while returned Fluent discrepancies update subsequent decisions. Across six public CFD benchmark campaigns, the framework reduces normalised worst-QoI error by 5.68-99.14% and accelerates decision-relevant computation by factors of 1.53-15.36 relative to a matched Generic Agent control. Applied to high-pressure steam dewaxing in investment casting, FastAgent identifies nonuniform condensation heating as the dominant startup mechanism and separates rapid risk-window localisation from high-fidelity melt-completion confirmation. The rapid route requires 81.39% fewer cell-time updates than a fine-grid, small-time-step reference. Structural analysis localises fracture at the observed blade edge. Screening 131,072 outlet layouts and selectively evaluating candidates with Fluent and Abaqus identifies Sparse-6, which reduces simulated crack opening by 96.0% and connected crack extent by 66.7% relative to the Original design. These results demonstrate how rapid numerical evidence and adaptive fidelity control connect large CFD search spaces to mechanism-guided industrial design.

AI.brief_summary: FastAgent 以轻量数值引擎 FastFluent 为核心构建物理感知的控制流程，按当前关注的 QoI 自适应分配物理模型、数值分辨率与模拟时长，并用 Fluent 返回的偏差更新后续决策，用于 CFD 快速筛查与工业蒸汽脱蜡设计。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按需提升保真度、以误差反馈调整后续查询与评估的机制，可能为 LVR 中动态计算预算、证据获取与「何时停止/升级」的权衡提供类比线索，但该工作面向工业 CFD，与视觉语言内部状态无直接关系，迁移价值尚待核查。
